title: 屋根付きの野鳥給餌台
description: 住宅の庭や公園の景観に使う、四方が開いた屋根付き給餌台。排水用の実際の隙間を持つ板張りトレー、低い縁、4本の屋根支柱、切妻の板屋根、筋交い付きの台座を備えます。巣箱ではありません。鳥・餌・水・地面は含まず、給餌の適否や衛生・動物の健康、安全性を保証しません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.880 × 1.772 × 0.791 m、6,488三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: An open-sided roofed feeding tray for residential-garden and park scenery, with a slatted tray containing actual drainage gaps, low rims, four canopy posts, a gabled plank roof and a braced pedestal. It is not a nest box. Birds, food, water and ground are omitted; no feeding suitability, hygiene, animal-health or safety performance is claimed. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.880 × 1.772 × 0.791 m; 6,488 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
